_provenance.source: OpenCode 官方控制台源码(subscription.get 返回 rollingUsage/weeklyUsage/usagePercent/resetInSec) 与 CodexBar opencode provider 解析文档一致
_provenance.note: 顶层分 rollingUsage/weeklyUsage/monthlyUsage 三档；每档 {usagePercent, resetInSec}；usagePercent 0-100；resetInSec 为相对秒偏移(如 1200=从现在起1200秒)，解析须转换绝对 ISO-UTC，禁止把数字塞进 resetAt
